title: senna birostris var. helveola
intro: Senna birostris var. helveola, commonly known as Cassia auriculata, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, diarrhea, and constipation, due to its purgative properties. The therapeutic actions of Cassia auriculata include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses.
